description: Process a opens a snapshot, a dynaset, a forward-only recordset (each over rows 1-8) and a table-type recordset (PK_T), reads rows 1 and 2 of each (visited) and leaves each positioned on row 3 (unread). Process b updates N of row 1 (visited), row 3 (current) and row 6 (unread), deletes row 4, and inserts rows 0 and 65. Process a reads the current row and then every remaining row of each cursor, then MoveFirst and reads again, then Requery of the three query cursors and reads, then a new snapshot. Visited versus unread, member versus value, and cursor kind are read separately.
retentionNote: Designed r-lock-3-4-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
